translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Putai he was removed as supervisor of military affairs in the three provinces of the two Qi and east Qin, commissioner third rank, and governor of Qi Province; he advanced to Duke of Qingshui commandery; his fief was increased together with the previous to three thousand households.

sentences.zh: 尋加侍中，給後部鼓吹，進位開府儀同三司，兼尚書左僕射、隴右行臺，仍停高平。

translations.literal: Soon he was added attendant-in-ordinary, given rear guard musical accompaniment, advanced to commissioner with third-rank protocol, and concurrently left vice director of the masters of writing and Longyou mobile headquarters; he still halted at Gaoping.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was added attendant-in-ordinary, given rear guard musical accompaniment, advanced to commissioner with third-rank protocol, and concurrently left vice director of the masters of writing and Longyou mobile headquarters; he still halted at Gaoping.

sentences.zh: 二年，加都督三雍三秦二岐二華諸軍事、雍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second year he was added supervisor of military affairs in the three Yong, three Qin, two Qi, and two Hua regions and governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was added supervisor of military affairs in the three Yong, three Qin, two Qi, and two Hua regions and governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 天光將率衆拒齊神武，遣問計于岳。

translations.literal: Tianguang was about to lead the host to resist Gao Huan and sent to ask Yue's counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Tianguang was about to lead the host to resist Gao Huan and sent to ask He Bayue's counsel.

sentences.zh: 岳報曰：「王家跨據三方，士馬殷盛，高歡烏合之衆，豈能為敵。

translations.literal: Yue replied: "The royal house holds three regions; soldiers and horses are abundant and flourishing—Gao Huan's mob-gathered host, how can it be a match?
translations.idiomatic: He Bayue replied: "The royal house holds three regions; soldiers and horses are abundant and flourishing—Gao Huan's mob-gathered host, how can it be a match?

sentences.zh: 然師克在和，但願同心戮力耳。

translations.literal: Yet armies conquer through harmony—I only wish we may with one heart exert our strength.
translations.idiomatic: Yet armies conquer through harmony—I only wish we may with one heart exert our strength.

sentences.zh: 若骨肉離隔，自相猜貳，則圖存不暇，安能制人。

translations.literal: If flesh and bone are separated, and we mutually suspect and divide, then scheming to survive will leave no leisure—how could we control others?
translations.idiomatic: If flesh and bone are separated, and we mutually suspect and divide, then scheming to survive will leave no leisure—how could we control others?

sentences.zh: 如下官所見，莫若且鎮關中，以固根本；

translations.literal: As this subordinate sees it, there is nothing better than for now to hold Guanzhong and solidify the root foundation;
translations.idiomatic: As I see it, there is nothing better than for now to hold Guanzhong and solidify the root foundation;

sentences.zh: 分遣銳師，與衆軍合勢。

translations.literal: separately dispatch crack divisions to combine force with the mass of armies.
translations.idiomatic: separately dispatch crack divisions to combine force with the mass of armies.

sentences.zh: 進可以克敵，退可以克全。

translations.literal: Advancing, one can conquer the foe; retreating, one can preserve oneself whole.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing, one can conquer the foe; retreating, one can preserve oneself whole.

sentences.zh: 」天光不從，果敗。

translations.literal: " Tianguang did not follow; he was indeed defeated.
translations.idiomatic: " Tianguang did not follow; he was indeed defeated.

sentences.zh: 岳率軍下隴赴雍，擒天光弟顯壽以應齊神武。

translations.literal: Yue led the army down Long to go to Yong, captured Tianguang's younger brother Xianshou to respond to Gao Huan.
translations.idiomatic: He Bayue led the army down Long to go to Yong, captured Tianguang's younger brother Xianshou to respond to Gao Huan.

sentences.zh: 魏孝武卽位，加關中大行臺，增邑千戶。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu of Wei ascended the throne, Yue was added grand headquarters of Guanzhong; his fief was increased by a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu of Wei ascended the throne, He Bayue was added grand headquarters of Guanzhong; his fief was increased by a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 永熙二年，孝武密令岳圖齊神武，遂刺心血，持以寄岳，詔岳都督二雍二華二岐豳四梁三益巴二夏蔚寧涇二十州諸軍事、大都督。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongxi, Xiaowu secretly ordered Yue to plot against Gao Huan; he then pricked his heart blood and sent it to Yue; an edict made Yue supervisor of military affairs in the twenty provinces of the two Yong, two Hua, two Qi, Bin, the four Liang, the three Yi, Ba, the two Xia, Yu, Ning, and Jing, and grand commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongxi (533), Emperor Xiaowu secretly ordered He Bayue to plot against Gao Huan; he then pricked his heart blood and sent it to He Bayue; an edict made He Bayue supervisor of military affairs in the twenty provinces of the two Yong, two Hua, two Qi, Bin, the four Liang, the three Yi, Ba, the two Xia, Yu, Ning, and Jing, and grand commander.

sentences.zh: 齊神武旣忌岳兄弟功名，岳懼，乃與太祖協契。

translations.literal: Gao Huan already envied the Yue brothers' achievement and fame; Yue feared, and thereupon made a covenant with the Grand Progenitor.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan already envied the Yue brothers' achievement and fame; He Bayue feared, and thereupon made a covenant with Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai.

sentences.zh: 語在《太祖本紀》。

translations.literal: The account is in the Basic Annals of the Grand Progenitor.
translations.idiomatic: The account is in the Basic Annals of Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai.

sentences.zh: 岳自詣北境，安置邊防。

translations.literal: Yue personally went to the northern frontier and settled the border defense.
translations.idiomatic: He Bayue personally went to the northern frontier and settled the border defense.

sentences.zh: 率衆趣平涼西界，布營數十里，托以牧馬於原州，為自安之計。

translations.literal: He led the host toward the western border of Pingliang, spread camps for several tens of li, and under pretext of pasturing horses at Yuan Province made a plan for self-security.
translations.idiomatic: He led the host toward the western border of Pingliang, spread camps for several tens of li, and under pretext of pasturing horses at Yuan Province made a plan for self-security.

sentences.zh: 先是，費也頭万俟受洛幹、鐵勒斛律沙門、斛拔彌俄突、紇豆陵伊利等，竝擁衆自守，至是皆款附。

translations.literal: Earlier, Feiyetou Moqi Shouluogan, Tiele Hulu Shamen, Hubo Mi'etuo, and Hedouling Yili and others had all held hosts and guarded themselves; at this time all came to submit allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Feiyetou Moqi Shouluogan, Tiele Hulu Shamen, Hubo Mi'etuo, and Hedouling Yili and others had all held hosts and guarded themselves; at this time all came to submit allegiance.

sentences.zh: 秦、南秦、河、渭四州刺史又會平涼，受岳節度。

translations.literal: The governors of Qin, south Qin, He, and Wei provinces again met at Pingliang and received Yue's command.
translations.idiomatic: The governors of Qin, south Qin, He, and Wei provinces again met at Pingliang and received He Bayue's command.

sentences.zh: 唯靈州刺史曹泥不應召，乃通使于齊神武。

translations.literal: Only Ling Province governor Cao Ni did not respond to the summons; he then sent envoys to Gao Huan.
translations.idiomatic: Only Ling Province governor Cao Ni did not respond to the summons; he then sent envoys to Gao Huan.

sentences.zh: 三年，岳召侯莫陳悅于高平，將討之，令悅為前驅。

translations.literal: In the third year Yue summoned Houmo Chenyue at Gaoping, intending to attack Ni, and made Chenyue the vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year He Bayue summoned Houmo Chenyue at Gaoping, intending to attack Ni, and made Chenyue the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 而悅受齊神武密旨圖岳，〔岳〕弗之知也，而先又輕悅。

translations.literal: But Chenyue received Gao Huan's secret order to plot against Yue; [Yue] did not know it, and earlier had also looked down on Chenyue.
translations.idiomatic: But Chenyue received Gao Huan's secret order to plot against He Bayue; He Bayue did not know it, and earlier had also looked down on Chenyue.

sentences.zh: 悅乃誘岳入營，共論兵事，令其婿元洪景斬岳於幕中。

translations.literal: Chenyue then lured Yue into camp, together discussed military affairs, and had his son-in-law Yuan Hongjing behead Yue in the tent.
translations.idiomatic: Chenyue then lured He Bayue into camp, together discussed military affairs, and had his son-in-law Yuan Hongjing behead He Bayue in the tent.

sentences.zh: 朝野莫不痛惜之。

translations.literal: Court and countryside all deeply mourned him.
translations.idiomatic: Court and countryside all deeply mourned him.

sentences.zh: 贈侍中、太傅、錄尚書、都督關中三十州諸軍事、大將軍、雍州刺史，諡曰武壯，葬以王禮。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was given attendant-in-ordinary, grand tutor, recorder of the masters of writing, supervisor of military affairs in the thirty provinces of Guanzhong, grand general, and governor of Yong Province; posthumous title Wuzhuang; he was buried with princely rites.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was given attendant-in-ordinary, grand tutor, recorder of the masters of writing, supervisor of military affairs in the thirty provinces of Guanzhong, grand general, and governor of Yong Province; posthumous title Wuzhuang; he was buried with princely rites.

sentences.zh: 子緯嗣，拜開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: His son Wei succeeded, was appointed commissioner with third-rank protocol.
translations.idiomatic: His son He Wei succeeded, was appointed commissioner with third-rank protocol.

sentences.zh: 保定中，錄岳舊德，進緯爵霍國公，尚太祖女。

translations.literal: During Baoding, recording Yue's old merit, Wei was advanced in rank to Duke of Huo state, and married the Grand Progenitor's daughter.
translations.idiomatic: During Baoding (561–565), in recognition of Heba Yue's past service, Wei was enfeoffed Duke of Huo and married a daughter of Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai.

sentences.zh: 侯莫陳悅，少隨父為駝牛都尉。

translations.literal: Houmochen Yue, in youth followed his father to serve as commander of camel oxen.
translations.idiomatic: Houmochen Yue in youth followed his father and served as camel-herd commandant.

sentences.zh: 長於西，好田獵，便騎射。

translations.literal: He grew up in the west, loved hunting, and was skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: Raised in the west, he loved the chase and was adept at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 會牧子作亂，遂歸爾朱榮。

translations.literal: When Mu Zi rebelled, he thereupon went over to Erzhu Rong.
translations.idiomatic: When Mu Zi rose in rebellion, he went over to Erzhu Rong.

sentences.zh: 榮引為府長流參軍，稍遷大都督。

translations.literal: Rong brought him in as chief adjutant for long-term service in the headquarters, and soon transferred him to great governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Rong made him chief adjutant on the staff and soon promoted him to great governor-general.

sentences.zh: 魏孝莊帝初，除征西將軍、金紫光祿大夫、封柏人縣侯，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei, he was appointed general who subdues the west, grand master with golden seal and purple ribbon, enfeoffed Marquis of Bai county, fief five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei's reign (528), he was appointed general of the west and grand master with golden seal and purple ribbon, enfeoffed Marquis of Bo county with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 爾朱天光西討，榮以悅為天光右都督，本官如故。

translations.literal: Erzhu Tianguang campaigned west; Rong made Yue Tianguang's right commander-in-chief, his original offices unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Tianguang marched west, Rong assigned Houmochen Yue as Tianguang's deputy commander-in-chief while retaining his existing posts.

sentences.zh: 西伐克獲，功亞於賀拔岳。

translations.literal: In the western campaign he captured enemy; his achievement was second to Heba Yue.
translations.idiomatic: In the western campaign he took many captives; his merit ranked second only to Heba Yue.

sentences.zh: 以本將軍除鄯州刺史。

translations.literal: With his existing generalship he was made governor of Shanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Retaining his general's commission, he was appointed governor of Shan Province.

sentences.zh: 建明中，拜車騎大將軍、渭州刺史，進爵白水郡公，增邑五百戶。

translations.literal: During Jianming, he was appointed grand general of chariots and cavalry and governor of Weizhou, advanced to Duke of Baishui commandery, fief increased five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: During Jianming (530), he was made grand general of chariots and cavalry and governor of Wei Province, advanced to Duke of Baishui with an additional five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 普泰中，除驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、秦州刺史。

translations.literal: During Putai, he was appointed grand general of agile cavalry, equal in rank to three ministers, and governor of Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During Putai (531), he was appointed grand general of agile cavalry with privilege equal to three ministers, and governor of Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 及天光赴洛，悅與岳俱下隴趣雍州，擒天光弟顯壽。

translations.literal: When Tianguang went to Luoyang, Yue and Yue both descended from Long down toward Yong Province and captured Tianguang's younger brother Xianshou.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianguang marched to Luoyang, Houmochen Yue and Heba Yue together descended from Long and pressed toward Yong Province, capturing Tianguang's younger brother Xianshou.

sentences.zh: 魏孝武初，加開府儀同三司、都督隴右諸軍事，仍加秦州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaowu of Wei, he was given privilege to open an office equal to three ministers, commander of all military affairs of Long right, and still added governor of Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaowu of Wei's reign (532), he received the privilege to open a government office with rank equal to three ministers, was made commander of all military affairs of Longyou, and retained the governorship of Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 及悅殺岳，岳衆莫不服從。

translations.literal: When Yue killed Yue, Yue's troops none did not submit and obey.
translations.idiomatic: After Houmochen Yue murdered Heba Yue, Heba Yue's army submitted to him without exception.

sentences.zh: 悅猶豫，不卽撫納，乃遷隴右。

translations.literal: Yue hesitated and did not immediately soothe and accept them; he then moved to Long right.
translations.idiomatic: Houmochen Yue hesitated and failed to promptly reassure and enroll them; he then shifted to Longyou.

sentences.zh: 太祖勒衆討之，悅遂亡敗。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor led troops to attack him; Yue then fled and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai led an army against him, and Houmochen Yue was routed in flight.

sentences.zh: 語在《太祖本紀》。

translations.literal: The account is in the "Annals of the Grand Progenitor."
translations.idiomatic: The account is in the "Annals of Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai."

sentences.zh: 悅子弟及同謀殺岳者八九人，竝伏誅。

translations.literal: Yue's sons, younger brothers, and those together plotting to kill Yue—eight or nine men—all suffered execution.
translations.idiomatic: Some eight or nine men, including Houmochen Yue's kin and co-conspirators in Heba Yue's murder, were all executed.

sentences.zh: 唯中兵參軍豆盧光走至靈州，後奔晉陽。

translations.literal: Only middle-army adjutant Doulu Guang fled to Lingzhou; afterward he fled to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: Only middle-army adjutant Doulu Guang escaped to Ling Province and later fled to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 悅自殺岳後，神情恍忽，不復如常。

translations.literal: After Yue killed Yue, his spirit and expression were dazed and absent; he was no longer as before.
translations.idiomatic: After murdering Heba Yue, Houmochen Yue grew absent and distraught, no longer his old self.

sentences.zh: 恒言「我纔睡卽夢見岳云：『兄欲何處去！

translations.literal: He constantly said: "As soon as I sleep I dream of Yue saying: 'Elder brother, where do you wish to go!
translations.idiomatic: He kept saying: "No sooner do I fall asleep than I dream of Heba Yue saying: 'Brother, where are you going!

sentences.zh: 』隨逐我不相置」。

translations.literal: ' He follows and pursues me and will not leave me."
translations.idiomatic: ' He follows me relentlessly and will not let me be."

sentences.zh: 因此彌不自安，而致破滅。

translations.literal: Because of this he grew ever more ill at ease, and came to ruin and destruction.
translations.idiomatic: This left him ever more unsettled and brought about his downfall.

sentences.zh: 念賢字蓋盧。

translations.literal: Nian Xian, styled Gailu.
translations.idiomatic: Nian Xian, styled Gailu.

sentences.zh: 美容質，頗涉書史。

translations.literal: He had fine appearance and bearing, and had read broadly in books and history.
translations.idiomatic: Handsome in appearance, he had read widely in literature and history.

sentences.zh: 為兒童時，在學中讀書，有善相者過學，諸生競詣之，賢獨不往。

translations.literal: When he was a child, studying in school, a skilled physiognomancer passed the school; the students all rushed to visit him, but Xian alone did not go.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy at school, when a skilled physiognomancer passed by, his classmates all hurried to consult him; Xian alone stayed away.

sentences.zh: 笑謂諸生曰：「男兒死生富貴在天也，何遽相乎。

translations.literal: Smiling he said to the students: "A man's death, life, wealth, and honor are in Heaven—why so hastily seek physiognomy?
translations.idiomatic: He smiled and told his classmates: "A man's life and death, wealth and rank lie with Heaven—why rush to have your fortunes read?

sentences.zh: 」少遭父憂，居喪有孝稱。

translations.literal: " In youth he suffered his father's death; in mourning he had a reputation for filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: " In youth he lost his father; his mourning conduct won praise for filial piety.

sentences.zh: 後以破衛可孤功，除別將。

translations.literal: Later for merit in defeating Wei Kehu he was appointed separate general.
translations.idiomatic: Later, for defeating Wei Kehu, he was made a separate-force general.

sentences.zh: 尋招慰雲州高車、鮮卑等，皆降下之。

translations.literal: Soon he summoned and reassured Gaoche, Xianbei, and others of Yunzhou; all submitted and were brought down.
translations.idiomatic: He soon pacified the Gaoche and Xianbei of Yun Province, all of whom submitted.

sentences.zh: 除假節、平東將軍，封屯留縣伯，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: He was appointed with provisional credential, general who pacifies the east, enfeoffed Earl of Tunliu county, fief five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed provisional-credential general who pacifies the east and enfeoffed Earl of Tunliu with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 建義初，為大都督，鎮井陘，加撫軍將軍、黎陽郡守。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianyi, he was great governor-general, garrisoning Jingxing, added general who soothes the army and prefect of Liyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianyi (528), he was made great governor-general and garrisoned Jingxing, with the added titles of general who soothes the army and prefect of Liyang.

sentences.zh: 爾朱榮入洛，拜車騎將軍、右光祿大夫、太僕卿，兼尚書右僕射、東〔道〕行臺，進爵平恩縣公，增邑五百戶。

translations.literal: Erzhu Rong entered Luoyang; he was appointed general of chariots and cavalry, right grand master for splendid virtue, grand master of splendid mounts, concurrently vice director of the Imperial Secretariat and Eastern [Route] mobile headquarters, advanced to Duke of Pingen county, fief increased five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong entered Luoyang, he was appointed general of chariots and cavalry, right grand master for splendid virtue, grand master of splendid mounts, and concurrently vice director of the Imperial Secretariat and chief of the Eastern Route expeditionary headquarters, advanced to Duke of Ping'en with an additional five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 普泰初，除使持節、瀛州諸軍事、驃騎將軍、瀛州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Putai, he was appointed bearer of the staff of authority, commander of all military affairs of Yingzhou, general of agile cavalry, and governor of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Putai, he was appointed with ceremonial staff, commander of Ying Province military affairs, general of agile cavalry, and governor of Ying Province.

sentences.zh: 永熙中，拜第一領民酋長，加散騎常侍，行南兗州事。

translations.literal: During Yongxi, he was appointed first tribal chieftain-overseer of settled peoples, added attendant in ordinary at the scattered cavalry, and acted for Nan Yanzhou affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During Yongxi (532–534), he was made first overseer of settled tribal peoples and attendant-in-ordinary, with provisional charge of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 尋進號驃騎大將軍，入為殿中尚書，加儀同三司。

translations.literal: Soon he advanced in title to grand general of agile cavalry, entered office as director in the palace department, and was added privilege equal to three ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to grand general of agile cavalry, entered court as director in the palace department, and received privilege equal to three ministers.

sentences.zh: 魏孝武欲討齊神武，以賢為中軍北面大都督，進爵安定郡公，增邑一千戶，加侍中、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu of Wei wished to attack Qi Divine Martial; he made Xian great governor-general of the north face of the central army, advanced to Duke of Anding commandery, fief increased one thousand households, added palace attendant and privilege to open an office equal to three ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu of Wei planned to attack Gao Huan (Qi Divine Martial), he made Nian Xian great governor-general of the central army's northern wing, advanced him to Duke of Anding with an additional one thousand households, and added palace attendant and privilege to open a government office equal to three ministers.

sentences.zh: 大統初，拜太尉，出為秦州刺史，加太傅，給後部鼓吹。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Datong, he was appointed grand commandant, went out as governor of Qinzhou, added grand tutor, and given rear guard martial music.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Datong (535), he was appointed grand commandant and went out as governor of Qin Province, with the added title of grand tutor and a grant of rear guard martial music.

sentences.zh: 三年，轉太師、都督河涼瓜鄯渭洮沙七州諸軍事、大將軍、河州刺史。

translations.literal: In the third year, he transferred to grand preceptor, commander of all military affairs of the seven provinces He, Liang, Gua, Shan, Wei, Tao, and Sha, grand general, and governor of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Datong, he was transferred to grand preceptor, made commander of all military affairs in He, Liang, Gua, Shan, Wei, Tao, and Sha provinces, grand general, and governor of He Province.

sentences.zh: 久之還朝，兼錄尚書事。

translations.literal: After long time he returned to court and concurrently recorded the affairs of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he returned to court and concurrently oversaw the affairs of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 河橋之役，賢不力戰，乃先還，自是名譽頗減。

translations.literal: In the battle of He Bridge, Xian did not exert himself in battle and returned first; from then his reputation greatly diminished.
translations.idiomatic: At the battle of He Bridge, Nian Xian failed to fight hard and withdrew early; his reputation thereafter suffered.

sentences.zh: 五年，除都督秦渭原涇四州諸軍事、秦州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he was appointed commander of all military affairs of the four provinces Qin, Wei, Yuan, and Jing, and governor of Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, he was appointed commander of all military affairs in Qin, Wei, Yuan, and Jing provinces and governor of Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 薨於州。

translations.literal: He died at the province.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office at Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 諡曰昭定。

translations.literal: Posthumous title: Zhaoding.
translations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Zhaoding (Illustrious and Settled).

sentences.zh: 賢於諸公皆為父黨，自太祖以下，咸拜敬之。

translations.literal: Xian toward all the dukes was all fathers' generation; from the Grand Progenitor down, all bowed and respected him.
translations.idiomatic: To all the princes and dukes, Nian Xian was of their fathers' generation; from Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai downward, all treated him with deference.

sentences.zh: 子華，性和厚，有長者風。

translations.literal: His son Hua, by nature gentle and generous, had the air of an elder of worth.
translations.idiomatic: His son Hua was gentle and generous, with the bearing of a man of mature virtue.

sentences.zh: 官至開府儀同三司、合州刺史。

translations.literal: In office he reached privilege to open an office equal to three ministers and governor of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to the privilege to open a government office equal to three ministers and governor of He Province.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：勝、岳昆季，以勇略之姿，當馳競之際，竝邀時投隙，展效立功。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: Sheng and Yue, brothers of the same mother, with bearing of courage and stratagem, at a time of galloping rivalry, both seized the time and sought openings, displaying effort and establishing achievement.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer writes: Heba Sheng and Heba Yue, with courage and stratagem, in an age of furious rivalry both seized their moment and won distinction.

sentences.zh: 始則委質爾朱，中乃結款高氏，太昌之後，卽帝圖高，察其所由，固非守節之士。

translations.literal: At first they entrusted themselves to Erzhu; in the middle they formed good relations with the Gao clan; after Taichang they immediately plotted kingship with Gao; examining the source of this, they were assuredly not men who kept integrity.
translations.idiomatic: At first they submitted to the Erzhus; then they made terms with the Gaos; after Taichang (530) they promptly turned toward Gao Huan's designs— plainly, neither was a man of steadfast loyalty.

sentences.zh: 及勝垂翅江左，憂魏室之危亡，奮翼關西，感梁朝之顧遇，有長者之風矣。

translations.literal: When Sheng drooped his wings on the Jiang left, grieving the Wei house's peril and extinction, and flapped his wings in Guan west, moved by the Liang dynasty's gracious treatment—he had the air of an elder of worth.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when Sheng, wings clipped in the south, grieved for the Wei house and then spread his wings again in the west, grateful for the Liang court's favor, he showed the bearing of a man of mature virtue.

sentences.zh: 終能保其榮寵，良有以焉。

translations.literal: In the end he could preserve his glory and favor—well did he have cause for it.
translations.idiomatic: That he kept his honors to the end is not surprising.

sentences.zh: 岳以二千之羸兵，抗三秦之勍敵，奮其智勇，克翦凶渠，雜種畏威，遐方慕義，斯亦一時之盛也。

translations.literal: Yue with two thousand worn troops resisted the three Qin's fierce enemy, exerted his wisdom and courage, was able to cut down the evil ringleader; mixed peoples feared his might, distant regions admired his righteousness—this too was a glory of the age.
translations.idiomatic: With two thousand exhausted troops Heba Yue held off the formidable foes of the three Qin, brought his wisdom and courage to bear, and destroyed a murderous chieftain; mixed tribes feared his might and distant regions admired his justice—a momentary zenith indeed.

sentences.zh: 卒以勳高速禍，無備嬰戮。

translations.literal: He finally because of merit high met speedy calamity; without preparation he encountered execution.
translations.idiomatic: Yet his towering merit hastened disaster, and unprepared he met the blade.

sentences.zh: 惜哉！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: What a pity!

sentences.zh: 陳涉首事不終，有漢因而創業；

translations.literal: Chen She first raised the affair but did not finish; Han thereupon thereby founded the enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Chen She launched the uprising but did not live to finish it; the Han dynasty arose from that beginning.

sentences.zh: 賀拔元功夙殞，太祖藉以開基。

translations.literal: Heba's primal achievement early perished; the Grand Progenitor by it opened the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Heba Yue's founding merit perished early; Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai built on it to open his dynasty.

sentences.zh: 「不有所廢，君何以興」，信乎其然矣。

translations.literal: "If nothing is discarded, how could the lord rise?"—surely it is so indeed.
translations.idiomatic: "If one man is not set aside, how can the ruler rise?"—how true that proved.

sentences.zh: 全文以中華書局、一九七一年十一月版《周書》為本校。

translations.literal: The entire text uses the Zhonghua Shuju, November 1971 edition of the Book of Zhou, as the base for this collation.
translations.idiomatic: This text was collated against the Zhonghua Shuju edition of the 《Book of Zhou》 (November 1971).
